title_en: Course Registration Change and Cancellation for the 2nd Semester (Fall) of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: This notice announces the schedule for changing and cancelling course registrations for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year, including a separate over-quota request period for undergraduate courses of the 전기·정보공학부 and deadlines for related requests. The general change and cancellation period is not stated in the notice text and is referred to the attachments.
applies_to: Students changing or cancelling course registrations for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year. The separate over-quota request period applies only to undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Information Engineering [전기·정보공학부]. Other items apply to students in the situations described: courses requiring approval to drop, duplicate course registration, remote classes during military leave of absence, course classification changes, and the grading option for major courses of other departments.

dates.what: Over-quota request period for undergraduate courses offered by the 전기·정보공학부 (deadline strictly enforced)
Deadline for students on military leave of absence to request a change to remote class registration on 장병e음
Deadline for registration and approval of course classification changes (one-quarter point of instructional days)
Deadline to apply in mySNU for the grading option for major courses of other departments (one-quarter point of instructional days)

steps: Read the attached files and the required-reading link in the notice for full details, including the general change and cancellation period, which is not stated in the notice text.

If you need an over-quota place in an undergraduate course offered by the 전기·정보공학부, submit the over-quota request between 1 September 2026 (Tue) and 3 September 2026 (Thu), 18:00, and make sure you understand the periods and method for each stage: request, instructor approval and enrollment confirmation.
If you wish to drop a course that requires approval, submit the course cancellation request within the period.

If you need duplicate course registration, apply at 학사정보 > 수업/성적 > 수업 > 중복수강신청 (Academic Information > Classes/Grades > Classes > Duplicate Course Registration), referring to the manual, from 9/1 (Tue) to 9/9 (Wed).
If you are on military leave of absence and taking remote classes, request the registration change yourself on 장병e음 by 17 September 2026 (Thu).
If you need to change a course classification, complete the registration and approval of the change by 23 September 2026 (Wed).
If you wish to use the grading option for major courses of other departments, check the course list at the linked spreadsheet and apply yourself in mySNU by 23 September 2026 (Wed).
translation:
We announce the schedule for course registration change and cancellation for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year. Please refer to the attached files for details.

1. Course Registration Change and Cancellation Period
(Note: the general change and cancellation period is not given in the text of the notice; it appears to be in the attached files, which were not read.)
※ For undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Information Engineering [전기·정보공학부] only, the over-quota request period is operated on a separate schedule*. Please take care not to make a mistake.
* Over-quota request period for undergraduate courses: 2026.09.01. (Tue) to 09.03. (Thu), 18:00 (deadline strictly enforced)
[Required reading] https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915

2. Important Notes
1) [Course Cancellation (수강신청 취소)] For courses that require approval, students must make sure to submit the course cancellation request within the period.
2) [Over-Quota Request (정원 외 신청)] Students must be familiar with the periods and method for the request, instructor approval and enrollment confirmation stages.
3) [Duplicate Course Registration (중복수강신청)] Apply at 학사정보 > 수업/성적 > 수업 > 중복수강신청 (Academic Information > Classes/Grades > Classes > Duplicate Course Registration) (refer to the manual), 9/1 (Tue) to 9/9 (Wed).
3) [Remote Classes during Military Leave of Absence (군휴학 원격수업)] Students must request the course registration change themselves on 장병e음 by 2026.09.17. (Thu).
4) [Course Classification Change (교과구분변경)] Registration and approval of course classification changes must be completed by 2026.09.23. (Wed), the one-quarter point of instructional days.
5) [Grading Option for Major Courses of Other Departments (타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제)] Students must apply themselves in mySNU by 2026.09.23. (Wed), the one-quarter point of instructional days.
Course list ▶ https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LNFU7Q_X_-RghkrtJ7WMsVyIdXdCHBAcbiGJ5xqcphg/edit?usp=sharing

(Note: the numbering "3)" appears twice in the original notice.)
